The '''Kothlis spynet facility''' was a [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] that was strategically crucial to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around the [[22 BBY/Legends|first year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|briefly seized]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] before [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] managed to retake it with his [[Troop/Legends|troops]].<ref name="CW" />
